description: UI improvements: Replace emoji control bar buttons with text labels, add save file naming, add backlog search, fix backlog persistence, and add message rollback/rewind feature
steps: 1. In index.html, replace the control bar emoji buttons: change the save button from the floppy emoji to text 'Save', the load button from the folder emoji to text 'Load', the settings button from the gear emoji to text 'Set', and the title/home button from the house emoji to text 'Menu'. Keep A, arrows, and triple-bar as they are since those are already text-like.
2. In css/ui.css, adjust .ctrl-btn styles to accommodate text labels that may be wider than the current 2.4rem square buttons. Change width to auto with min-width and add horizontal padding.
3. In js/save.js, modify the save data structure to include a user-defined 'name' field. Add a renameSave(slot, newName) function. Update listSaves() to return the custom name.

4. In js/ui.js showSave() function, add a text input or prompt that lets the user set/change the name of a save slot when saving. When clicking a slot in save mode, prompt for a name (default to the scene id). Display the custom name in the slot UI. Add a small rename/edit button on each filled slot that triggers a rename prompt.

5. In index.html, add a search input field inside the backlog modal (between h2 and backlog-entries div). In js/ui.js showBacklog(), wire up the search input to filter backlog entries by text content (case-insensitive substring match). Show/hide entries based on the filter.
6. In css/ui.css, add styles for the backlog search input (consistent with the game's dark purple theme).

7. Fix backlog persistence: In js/engine.js snapshot(), include state.backlog in the snapshot. In restore(), restore the backlog from the snap. In js/save.js, the backlog is already part of the Engine state but is reset on Engine.reset(). Modify restore() to preserve backlog by restoring it from snap.backlog if present.

8. Add message rollback feature: In js/engine.js, maintain a history stack that stores snapshots at each dialogue step (say, narration, thought). Add a goBack() function that pops the last history entry and restores that state. Expose Engine.goBack(). In js/ui.js, add a 'Back' button to the control bar (or wire it to the backlog entries so clicking a backlog entry jumps back to that point). Add a 'Back' button to the control bar with data-action='back'. In bindControlBar(), handle the 'back' action by calling Engine.goBack().
9. In index.html, add the Back button to the control bar (between skip and backlog buttons, with text label or left-arrow).
acceptance_criteria: Control bar shows text labels 'Save' and 'Load' instead of emoji characters
Users can type a custom name when saving to a slot, and the name displays in the save/load modal
Backlog modal has a search/filter input that narrows displayed entries based on typed text
When loading a save, the backlog from that save session is restored (not empty)
A 'Back' button or mechanism exists that lets the player return to the previous dialogue message
python3 tests/test_walk.py still passes (scene graph is unaffected)
verification: Run: python3 tests/test_walk.py and confirm all scenes reachable and all endings accessible
Open index.html in a browser, confirm no JS console errors on load
Verify control bar visually shows text labels instead of emojis
